Third-party notices for SQLite Viewer
====================================

Keep this directory's license and author files with redistributed copies of
sql-wasm.js and sql-wasm.wasm.

sql.js 1.13.0
-------------
Copyright (c) 2017 sql.js authors (see AUTHORS.sql.js).
License text, including its additional Makefile attribution, is preserved
verbatim in LICENSE.sql.js. Author credits are in AUTHORS.sql.js.
Upstream source https://github.com/sql-js/sql.js/tree/v1.13.0
Upstream license https://github.com/sql-js/sql.js/blob/v1.13.0/LICENSE
Upstream authors https://github.com/sql-js/sql.js/blob/v1.13.0/AUTHORS

Emscripten runtime
------------------
sql.js distributes JavaScript and WebAssembly built using Emscripten.
The sql.js v1.13.0 development-container configuration pins Emscripten 4.0.5.
Its MIT and University of Illinois/NCSA license text and included Node.js
notice are preserved verbatim in LICENSE.emscripten.
Upstream license https://github.com/emscripten-core/emscripten/blob/4.0.5/LICENSE
Build configuration https://github.com/sql-js/sql.js/blob/v1.13.0/.devcontainer/Dockerfile

musl C runtime
--------------
Copyright and license notices for Emscripten's bundled musl runtime are
preserved verbatim in COPYRIGHT.musl, including its contributor credits
and third-party component descriptions.
Upstream notice https://github.com/emscripten-core/emscripten/blob/4.0.5/system/lib/libc/musl/COPYRIGHT

SQLite
------
SQLite's deliverable code and documentation are dedicated to the public domain.
Official statement https://sqlite.org/copyright.html

Python runtime
--------------
The local launcher uses a separately installed Python interpreter and its
standard library. Python is supplied by the user's own installation.
